content.text:
I've updated `.github/workflows/ci.yml` so the "Upload test results to Codecov" step uses `codecov/codecov-action` instead of the deprecated `codecov/test-results-action`. CI now runs that action twice: once for coverage (unchanged) and once for test results.

The repo already pins `codecov-action` at v7.1.1, which is newer than the v5 the notice mentions and supports `report_type: test_results`. So I reused that same pinned version rather than going back to v5. The new step:

```yaml
- name: Upload test results to Codecov
  if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
  uses: codecov/codecov-action@303a32d7a59b442fa8d48b6a1cc6825c09c847a5 # v7.1.1
  with:
    token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
    slug: chrisdoc/surveybeat-next
    report_type: test_results
    files: test-report.junit.xml
```

`test-report.junit.xml` is the file `pnpm test:ci` already writes. The step keeps `if: ${{ !cancelled() }}`, so test results still upload when tests fail. Nothing else in the repo refers to the old action.

I only checked that the YAML parses. I couldn't run `actionlint` here, and the change won't really be tested until CI runs on GitHub.

`git diff` also shows a change to `.githooks/post-commit` that I didn't make. It may be from another session, so I left it alone. Nothing is committed yet; tell me if you want this committed or pushed with a PR.
